reported.title: Incorrect pulse timing due to overflow
reported.description: The variable 'nextDue' is cast to uint8_t, which can cause overflow and incorrect timing when the millis() value exceeds 255. This will lead to missed pulses and incorrect timing.

reported.title: Inconsistent pulse period when paused
reported.description: When the pause button is pressed, the next pulse timing is incorrectly calculated, which can lead to a situation where the pulse is emitted too soon after being unpaused.

truth.description: uint8_t schedule and byte PERIOD_MS wrap, drip cadence too fast

judge_input.spec:
- Drip solenoid driver on D8; pause button on D4 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW).
- Emit a 50 ms HIGH pulse on D8 every 800 ms while pause is released.
- Print the exact line `drip` at the start of each pulse; period must stay 800 ms ±120 ms.
- While D4 is held LOW, suppress new pulses and keep D8 LOW.
- Every 1600 ms print `drip n=<count> pause=<0|1>`.
- Stay responsive: complete each pulse without multi-second blocking waits.
